people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.
translations.bsb: Ephraim’s territory was to the south, and Manasseh’s was to the north, having the Sea as its border and adjoining Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
translations.kjv: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
translations.asv: southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea was his border; and they reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.
